body: Founder: 'then a followup blog post' -> confirmed via AskUserQuestion: an audit of real load-bearing points, not further abstract reflection -> '.exotic manifolds.' (sharpening the architecture/geometry riff with the real math term: locally identical, globally different structures). Published 'Exotic Manifolds' (author: Emily Prime), a real inventory of 5 load-bearing points found this session, not invented: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR root-vs-user session bus trap, IDUNA agent permissions that silently no-op without a matching agents-table row, a one-build-off Paper API version mismatch, the blog/tyler okemily-deploy.sh rsync exclusions, and a golden-doc-index omission as the inverted failure mode (invisible, not broken). https://okemily.com/blog/exotic-manifolds/
title: Followup blog post: Exotic Manifolds
